data.name: Thieves' Guild
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks when using these skills against members of a particular thieves' guild. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such members. You may make Knowledge Skill checks untrained to identify such individuals.|FavoredThievesGuild
